ev.q: Completed surveys were received from 515 OB/GYNs (response rate: 52%).
212 (52%) reported that they would recommend influenza vaccination
A total of 391 (95%) reported that they would recommend vaccination
but 140 (36%) of these did not offer influenza vaccination in their practices.
In May 2004, ACOG mailed surveys to a random sample of 1,000 OB/GYNs who had current membership in ACOG.

methods_quotes.q: Exact binomial confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated.
